body: Forward test of the base rate method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.38 (naive base rate 0.35) that: AMD Q4 2026 revenue is ≥$17.51B (above the top of its ~$17B ±3% guide). Evidence: 8-K 3-Nov-2026: Q3 2026 revenue record $13.4B (+45% YoY), 'exceeding the high end of our guidance'; Data Center nearly doubled. Q4 guide ~$17B ±3% (midpoint +66% YoY, +27% QoQ), non-GAAP GM ~55%. SEC XBRL quarterly revenue: $10.25B, $11.54B, $13.38B (Q1–Q3 2026). Reasoning: A +27% sequential guide already embeds a big MI-series ramp; beating the top needs supply upside on top of that. AMD's beat-the-top frequency is lower than NVIDIA's. Resolution: YES if AMD's reported Q4 2026 revenue (8-K earnings release) ≥ $17.51B. Source: AMD Q4 2026 earnings 8-K (SEC EDGAR, CIK 2488). Resolve by 2027-02-20; score with Brier vs base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: Large-cap semis beat the top of their own quarterly revenue range roughly a third of the time.

body: Promise-credibility forward test, Nov-2026 cohort (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Tatva Chintan Pharma Chem (TATVA). Probability 0.22 (naive sector base rate 0.22) that: Tatva Chintan Pharma Chem (TATVA) begins commercial supply to its hybrid-battery electrolyte-salt customer by 31-Dec-2026. Probabilities set only by the pre-registered rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/forward_test_2026-11/prereg.md s4): p0 = 0.222 (sector peers (Chemicals), all groups (group 'dates' n=1 < 8), n=9); N=1 < 3 so P_cred = P_base = 0.22. Evidence: call of 2025-10-31: "We can now clearly visualize commercialization on these batteries to begin in 2026" (Q2FY26); Q1FY27: "steadily moving towards commercial supply". Resolution: YES if a call/presentation/filing dated <= 15-Mar-2027 states commercial (not trial/validation) supplies to the hybrid-battery customer began on or before 31-Dec-2026. Source: company Q3/Q4 FY27 filings, presentations and call transcripts (NSE). Resolve by 2027-03-15; score Brier of P_cred vs P_base (prereg s5).
